body:
Adds `research/drag-twin`: a linear-drag twin of a quadratic-drag vehicle. Coast-down time and terminal speed are off by fit-speed ratios, a least-squares fit gives k = 3c·vmax/4, and the safe speed under a stopping-distance limit is mis-stated by −21% to +41% with the sign set by the fit speed. Stylised, pure Python, 10 tests. README bullet and site/projects.json entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
